summary: Formal classification of all explored and unexplored macro behaviors in Kaggriculture.

falsified_internal_families.causal_conclusion: Early expansion is catastrophic when insolvent (EXP-0121: 4.3% WR, -$4,069 MCV) and exactly neutral when solvent (EXP-0124: 50.0% WR, -$94 MCV). Land expansion timing itself is not a competitive edge against elite opponents.

open_causal_families.rationale: Direct game-theoretic front-running in shared order book. When opponent has full shed, liquidating 1 step earlier avoids 8.5% price crash.
Resource deprivation in shared zero-sum shop pool on Days 4-8.
Dynamic land expansion with strict $600 wage/seed solvency reserve.

invalid_mechanisms.reason: Shed inventory is strictly private to opponent.
Town pool size is 10,000 units ($250k capital needed to exhaust).
